YouTuber Santosh Pandit Detained Over Defamatory Video Against Maharashtra Minister

Social media influencer Santosh Pandit was detained early Wednesday morning following a defamation complaint filed by a Pune corporator. The complaint, lodged by Sunil Pande, alleged that Pandit used abusive and derogatory language against Maharashtra minister Chandrakant Patil in a video. The video reportedly contained obscene posts directed at the minister. Pandit was detained in connection with the case.
